items.headline: Oregon fires offensive coordinator Drew Mehringer after third straight loss
items.description: Oregon has fired offensive coordinator Drew Mehringer less than one full season after he was promoted to the job. Oregon is unranked and has lost three games this season after beginning the year ranked second in the preseason AP poll.

items.headline: Aidan Laughery, Collin Dixon score TDs as Illinois beats Oregon 21-10
items.description: — Aidan Laughery ran for 123 yards and a touchdown and Collin Dixon made a diving catch for a 23-yard score late in the fourth quarter as Illinois defeated Oregon 21-10 on Saturday.
